international.title: Australia’s national medical research body advises conditional use of puberty blockers for transgender children
international.summary: New National Health and Medical Research Council guidelines at odds with public hospital bans in Queensland and NT Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australia’s largest medical research organisation has advised puberty blockers are appropriate for the gender-affirming care of young people in certain circumstances, following a year-long review of international evidence. The federal government last year commissioned the commonwealth-funded National Health and Medical Research Council (NHMRC) to develop the advice in response to bans in Queensland and the Northern Territory public hospitals imposed by their governments.
